articles.title: Wild Things - Official Release Date Announcement Video - IGN
articles.summary:
Take a look at Wild Things in this video for the upcoming seven-episode original series starring Jude Law and Andrew Garfield as renowned showmen Siegfried & Roy. The series is created, written, directed, showrun and executive produced by eight-time Emmy Award nominee John Hoffman. Matt Shakman directs and executive produces, and Brian Grazer executive produces for Imagine Entertainment. Jude Law and Andrew Garfield serve as executive producers.Wild things tells the wild ride relationship tale of two of the greatest showmen-magicians in history who, along with their white tigers, are tasked with turning Sin City into a family-friendly destination. The duo push the concept of illusion versus reality to the extreme, personally and professionally, until tragedy reframes and opens a mystery surrounding their last fateful Las Vegas show. Law stars as Siegfried and Garfield stars as Roy, and Shakman directs the pilot. The ensemble cast also includes Jessica Madsen, Brett Gelman, Justin Theroux, Cameron Britton, Darius Fraser, Bill Heck, Justin Bartha, Jason Butler Harner and Wanda Opalinska. 

Hailing from Apple Studios, the limited series is based on the buzzy Apple Original Podcast, “Wild Things: Siegfried & Roy,” and produced by Imagine Entertainment.

Wild Things premieres on Apple TV on April 16, 2027.
